context: Tests handling of a vague prompt, an excessive iteration count, a missing doc-type and publication-format guidance.

checklist.name: Vague prompt challenged
checklist.description: Asks for or supplies specifics: flowchart type, components, flow direction, labels and style

checklist.name: Doc type set to journal
checklist.description: Passes --doc-type journal rather than relying on the default

checklist.name: Default threshold risk explained
checklist.description: Explains that the default 7.5 threshold is lower than the 8.5 journal threshold

checklist.name: Iterations capped at 2
checklist.description: Uses --iterations 2 or less and does not pass 5

checklist.name: Early stop explained
checklist.description: Explains the system stops once the quality threshold is met, so more iterations do not help

checklist.name: API key checked before running
checklist.description: Checks that ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set in the environment before generating

checklist.name: Key not hardcoded
checklist.description: Does not place a key in a command, script or file

checklist.name: Colourblind palette applied
checklist.description: Mentions or requests the Okabe-Ito colourblind-friendly palette

checklist.name: Vector or high-resolution output
checklist.description: Recommends PDF or SVG, or at least 300 DPI raster, for the manuscript

checklist.name: LaTeX inclusion
checklist.description: Shows or mentions including the figure with \includegraphics

checklist.name: Caption guidance
checklist.description: Says the figure needs a thorough caption defining all elements and abbreviations
